items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: we’ve had the band since 1986 ... the biggest part of our library is by Charlie Camilleri ... he wrote I would say over 40 or 50 arrangements for us.

ctx.x: Are you still a learner? Speaking of learning?

I try to attend as many — whenever I hear of a master class I try to go. I recently attended one on clarinet. I can’t remember the names of the two players, they were both great and it was like half and half — half the day and half the day — with these two amazing clarinetists teaching different students. And you know, I mean yeah, I try to learn, watch videos, go to master classes, whatever I have time for, go listen to players and I think that we always keep learning yeah, definitely. And plus I mean I’ve never…
And what’s it like trying to organize and get a gig for a big band?
